title: The Emotional Toll of Caregiving and How to Prevent Burnout
manual_rationale: Primarily explains caregiver burnout and coping strategies, with ElliQ promoted as a supporting tool. The main purpose is caregiver education and product promotion.

title: NYSOFA introduces ElliQ to older adults in New York
manual_rationale: Announces NYSOFA's rollout of ElliQ to over 800 older adults and its partnership with Intuition Robotics. The main purpose is to report a concrete deployment and adoption initiative.

title: How Technology Is Changing Caregiving at Home
manual_rationale: Primarily describes the functions and claimed caregiving benefits of home-care technologies and ElliQ. Classified under the codebook's inclusion of product-feature discussions. These are promotional company claims rather than independently evaluated performance.

title: How to Choose Between Home Care, Assisted Living, and Tech-Based Companionship
manual_rationale: Compares home care, assisted living, and technology-based companionship through their benefits and limitations. Positions ElliQ as complementary support for aging at home. Comparison between alternative care approaches is the article's central purpose.

title: What Yale Researchers Discovered About How You Think About Getting Older
manual_rationale: Primarily discusses positive aging beliefs and related research, using ElliQ as a promotional example. The cited research concerns aging mindset rather than evaluating ElliQ's performance or documenting its adoption.

title: The Future of Aging: Why Connection Matters More Than Care
manual_rationale: Uses a reported user experience and detailed descriptions of ElliQ's communication, engagement, and community features to explain its claimed benefits. This is promotional product-function content; the anecdotal health improvements do not establish causality.

title: ElliQ is 93-year-old Juanita’s friend. She’s also a robot
manual_rationale: Primarily profiles a user's real-world experience with ElliQ, including daily functions, observed interactions, and response or recognition failures. Ethical, privacy, and data-security concerns are substantial secondary themes.

title: Fari
manual_rationale: Primarily describes Fari's planned capabilities, technical architecture, and performance targets. Privacy, safety, and ethical governance are presented as product design requirements. These are development claims and targets rather than independently validated performance results.

title: The Benefits of Robotic Pets for Dementia, Loneliness
manual_rationale: Primarily discusses robotic pets' reported benefits and limitations through user experiences, cited studies, and expert commentary. Highlights variation in individual responses and potential anxiety or attachment issues. Distribution figures and purchasing options are secondary to the discussion of product outcomes.

title: ElliQ Review: a Robot Companion for Seniors │ The Senior List
manual_rationale: Primarily evaluates ElliQ through hands-on testing, covering setup, usability, features, reliability, and value. Reports both strengths and limitations, including video-call delays, system freezes, limited conversation, and missing emergency-response functionality. Comparisons with alternatives support the overall product review.

title: ElliQ, A Social Home Robot for Older Adults, Now Available for Pre-Order
manual_rationale: Primarily reports ElliQ's opening for pre-orders and transition toward commercial availability, including pricing, subscription terms, expected shipping, and a planned initial research deployment. Feature descriptions and concerns about cost and sustained use provide context rather than evidence of widespread adoption.

title: Your Parent Won’t Ask for Help. Here’s How to Know They Need It
manual_rationale: Primarily helps adult children recognize subtle signs of loneliness and support needs in aging parents, offering general guidance on long-distance caregiving. ElliQ is promoted as a supporting tool, but product-feature discussion is secondary to caregiver education.

title: ‘Care bots’ are on the rise and replacing human caregivers | Alexandra Mateescu and Virginia Eubanks
manual_rationale: Primarily examines ethical and governance risks of care automation, including surveillance, loss of privacy and autonomy, algorithmic bias, and opaque decisions about access to care. Product and policy examples support the central argument about potential harms.

title: AI in Caregiving: What It Can and Can’t Do
manual_rationale: Primarily explains the capabilities and limitations of AI caregiving tools, including reminders, companionship, and support for daily routines. Clarifies that these tools cannot replace clinical judgment, human relationships, or hands-on care, and positions ElliQ within this supporting role. This is a capability overview rather than independent testing.

title: How to Help an Aging Parent Stay Socially Connected
manual_rationale: Primarily provides caregiver guidance on helping aging parents maintain social connections through communication, shared activities, community participation, and mobility support. AI tools and ElliQ are promoted as supporting options within this broader advice, rather than being the focus of a product evaluation or comparison.

title: NYSOFA reports ElliQ pilot outcomes and partnership continuation
manual_rationale: Primarily reports the continuation of NYSOFA's partnership with Intuition Robotics following an ElliQ pilot involving more than 800 older adults. Reported engagement and wellbeing outcomes support the account of sustained institutional adoption and plans for broader deployment.

title: 10 Activities You Can Do with ElliQ This Month
manual_rationale: Primarily describes ten ElliQ features and practical usage scenarios, including social activities, video calling, wellness goals, emotional check-ins, and medication reminders. This is company-authored product guidance and promotion rather than an independent performance evaluation.

title: How AI companion robots are helping seniors feel less lonely
manual_rationale: Primarily profiles an older adult's experience with ElliQ, describing observed activities and perceived companionship benefits while noting that it does not match human conversation. Distribution figures and concerns about privacy and overdependence provide secondary context.

title: Caregiving for Aging Parents Is Costing a Generation Their Savings
manual_rationale: Positions ElliQ as an integrated and more affordable alternative to purchasing separate companionship, wellness, and communication services. Cost comparisons and bundled functionality form the central argument. The savings claims rely on company-provided estimates rather than independently verified comparisons.

title: ‘Care bots’: a dream for carers or a dangerous fantasy?
manual_rationale: Primarily examines the ethical implications of care automation, balancing relief from caregiver burden against potential losses of empathy, purpose, and human caregiving capabilities. Product examples and evidence of added workload support this broader discussion of risks and responsible use.
